name: Zipic
soft_passes: #3 silhouette: solid-black fill is a generic squircle; legibility rides entirely on internal figure-ground, not outline
#7 figure-ground: photo-on-body >7:1 but dial-face-on-body only ~2:1, separated by inset/shadow not tone
#10 variant robustness: era-exempt (Big Sur), but composition depends on the charcoal ground and would not survive Liquid Glass tinted/clear/mono without a re-author
#2 grid: balanced two-mass vertical composition, full-bleed 80.3% squircle
failures: #4 16px squint: verified downscale — dial, LEVEL text, numerals and tick marks smear to a gray blob; only the blue+white photo strip survives, compression idea lost; built for hero size not Dock/Spotlight
#12 no-text: baked text present — 'LEVEL' plus gauge numerals 0/5/10, the classic small-size liability that feeds the #4 smear

palette.background: ramp #626262->#3D3D3D (charcoal machine body, top-lit; corners vignette ~#242424)

light_model: single soft top-down studio light; body highlight at top decaying to shadow at bottom; short soft baked micro-shadows under the photo stack, inside the slot, and beneath the knob; matte finish, no specular glass highlights
layer_stack: recessed gauge panel + knurled LEVEL knob + yellow LED (inset)
stack of glossy photo prints emerging (front), top print carrying a blue landscape + gold sun
devices: feature-as-machine skeuomorphism (compression level as a physical LEVEL 0-10 dial/gauge)
photos physically dispensing from a slot as a stacked ream
matte soft-3D rendered-object register (Blender/C4D studio look)
rhymes_hint: Big Sur-era app-as-appliance rendered-object icons — utilities depicted as physical gadgets/machines under soft studio light (compression-as-press/printer metaphor family); NOT the flat-gradient-glyph family and NOT the Apple diagonal-tool family
notes: Source 512x512, likely a downscaled web render of a 1024 master — fine gauge text/ticks already soft in source, sub-pixel measurement limited. Squircle is full-bleed 411/512 = 80.3% (proper Big Sur proportion, ~822/1024 scaled), not a floating glyph. Soft outer drop shadow is BAKED into the PNG (alpha bbox 26-486 vs solid squircle 50-461); Apple HIG asks the system to apply the shadow, but baked shadows are common on macapp.supply renders and Big Sur third-party icons. Gold appears twice (LED + photo sun) as an intentional 'dial the level -> this comes out' rhyme. Brand-coherent with cover.png: charcoal grounds + periwinkle-blue headings + gold accents recur across the marketing, so icon and brand share one charcoal+indigo-blue+gold system. Strong personality (feature literalised as a machine) but two genuine small-size liabilities (detail smear + baked text) cap it at 10/12; a Dock-legible variant would drop the gauge text and thin the dial detail.
